review_description: Aussie Solar Tech has provided quotes quickly and patiently explained the installation process. The salesperson also kindly offered details on the solar systems and how they work. Because of the good price and the elaboration, I chose Aussie Solar Tech for the installation of the solar system for my house.

Sales process was reasonable using the opensolar tool.Installation was facilitated and casual. Installers just did the work .For customer service it could have been better , they could provide more services easily since my precise needs were scoped in advance.Electrical,  grid connection, and upgrades were all done well.For management software, I did it myself since the included platform made that easy.Everyone should also get a smart meter for monitoring.
